Job Description

Position: Financial Analyst Intern
Employer: Cavendish Grove Holdings Inc.
Job Location: Montreal, QC
Remote Status: On-site
Closing Date: 15/03/2027
Rate of Pay: $23.75 per hour
Length of Term: 8 months

Position Summary

Cavendish Grove Holdings Inc. is a diversified holdings company. The Financial Analyst
Intern will support FP&A processes including budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.

Key Responsibilities

- Assist with monthly financial planning cycles and reporting packages
- Prepare valuation support materials for the corporate development team
- Maintain financial models used in quarterly business reviews

Additional Information

Work Term: Winter 2027
This position is based in our Montreal office and requires full on-site presence.
Our company generated revenue of $1,200,000,000 in the prior fiscal year.
